The analyst notes Lynas faces a slower NdPr production ramp-up as customers increasingly require dysprosium and terbium alongside NdPr. Bell Potter lowers its target for New Hope to $4.80 from $5.30 but upgrades to Hold from Sell following share price weakness and new FY27 production guidance.
